language.description: CodeQL language identifier (e.g. javascript-typescript, rust, actions). Single language per call; multi-language wrappers invoke the reusable once per language.

build-mode.description: CodeQL build mode (none|autobuild|manual). 100% of estate currently uses "none"; override only for compiled languages that require explicit build.

runs-on.description: Runner label for the analyze job

config-file.description: Optional path to a CodeQL configuration file, relative to the checked-out repository (e.g. ./.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml). Empty by default, which is the CodeQL Action's own default and means NO configuration file: the Action does NOT auto-discover `.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml` (verified against codeql-action v4.38.0 — `getConfigFileInput()` returns undefined unless this input, a repository property, or default setup supplies a path), so a caller that wants one must name it here. An empty value is passed through as undefined by the Action, so existing callers are unaffected.
